Enter the link provided by your teacher or school admin Paste the link here Invalid link, try again Passwordless sign-in with passkeys How passkeys work?
What are passkeys? Passkeys are encrypted digital keys you create using your fingerprint, face or other screen-lock method.
Where are passkeys saved? They are saved to your password manager, so you can sign in on other devices.
Are they better than passwords? Passkeys protect you from phishing attacks. Passkeys work only on your registered apps and websites, and your password manager protects passkeys from unauthorized access and use. Signing in A passkey is a faster and safe way to sign in than a password.Your account is created with one unless you choose another option. Sign-up Other way to sign-in

RESPECT™ makes it easy to discover and use great edtech apps with a single account. Download lessons to use offline. RESPECT™'s compression can reduce data usage. Teachers can easily assign lessons from any edtech app on RESPECT™ as homework for students to complete on their parents' phone or any other device. Track progress with detailed reports.
